The helper methods are being renamed to `mulAv` and `mulAtv` for brevity. To optimize performance, the matrix entry formula will be inlined directly into these loops instead of calling a separate method, eliminating call overhead in the inner loop.

The implementation will use three double arrays: u, v, and tmp. The main method parses the command-line argument as the matrix size n, initializes u to all ones, and runs ten iterations of the power method by alternating between mult_Av and mult_Atv through the temporary buffer.

The class must be public and named `spectralnorm` to match the expected filename. The long arithmetic prevents integer overflow for large N, since n=1e7 would require roughly 2 MB of memory.
